items.description: Known as the City of Roses, Blida is located near the Chiffa Gorge and Atlas Mountains. It serves as an important agricultural and administrative hub south of Algiers.
A port city on the Mediterranean coast, Mostaganem features a mix of historic Andalusian influence and modern development. It is an active center for trade and tourism.
Located in the Gourara region, Timimoun is famous for its distinct red-ochre earthen architecture. It is an oasis town deeply connected to traditional desert culture.
Arzew is a major industrial hub and one of the largest petrochemical ports in the Mediterranean. It plays a critical role in Algeria's natural gas and oil exports.
This port serves as a vital logistics node for northern Algeria's commercial maritime traffic. It facilitates imports, exports, and regional trade.
Located in Jijel Province, Djendjen is one of the largest deep-water ports in Algeria. It is essential for heavy industry logistics and international shipping.
Ouenza is one of Algeria's most significant iron ore mining centers. It supplies domestic steel production and supports the nation's industrial sector.
Djebel Onk is the largest phosphate mining complex in the country. It is a cornerstone for the fertilizer industry and chemical sector.
In Amenas is a strategic natural gas production and processing facility in the Sahara. It significantly contributes to the national energy output.
This industrial complex is a major steel manufacturing facility in Jijel. It is designed to meet domestic demand and boost industrial capacity.
